frequency_question: How often do central government executives successfully deliver mandated major regulatory notifications under supreme court oversight within tight timelines?
membership_rule: Includes instances where a national supreme court mandates a specific executive ministry or cabinet to finalize and notify a contested public health or economic regulation by a fixed date. Excludes voluntary policy formulation without judicial mandates, and cases where no binding deadline was set.

coverage_note: 6 named cases representing major judicially mandated executive rule finalizations in comparable jurisdictions.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative compliance orders; focuses exclusively on high-visibility health and public welfare regulations.
validity_reason: Executive compliance behavior under supreme judicial pressure remains relatively stable across electoral cycles unless there is a complete overhaul of judicial enforcement powers.
